UAE intercepts Iranian drone amid heightened US-Iran tensions

The United Arab Emirates announced it intercepted an Iranian drone over its territorial waters. This incident occurred amidst a reported resumption of US-Iran confrontations after a month-long lull. Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei called for Muslim unity against the US and Israel, urging Gulf rulers to confront the 'real enemy'. Iran described an overnight US-Iran scuffle as a 'limited' confrontation.
